description_en: Detaches instance RAM roles from one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 本接口用于收回一台或多台ECS实例被授予的RAM角色
name: DetachInstanceRamRole

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance RAM role to detach. You can call the RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html to query the names of instance RAM roles that you have created
parameters.help_zh: 指定收回的实例RAM角色名称。您可以使用RAM API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html查询您已创建的实例RAM角色名称
parameters.name: ram_role_name

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs of the instances from which to detach the RAM role. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定收回的实例ID数组。数组长度：1~100
parameters.name: instance_ids

DetachInstanceRamRoleResult.description_en: The collection of results, including instance IDs and instance RAM role names (DetachInstanceRamRoleResult)
DetachInstanceRamRoleResult.description_zh: 由被收回的实例ID和收回实例RAM角色名称等（DetachInstanceRamRoleResult）组成的信息集

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the instance RAM role was detached successfully. A return value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. For more information about failure causes, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断是否成功收回实例RAM角色。返回值为200表示成功收回，返回其他值表示收回失败，失败原因参见错误码

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the instance from which the instance RAM role was detached
InstanceId.description_zh: 被收回实例RAM角色的实例ID

InstanceRamRoleSet.description_en: The collection of detached instance IDs and instance RAM role names
InstanceRamRoleSet.description_zh: 收回的实例ID和实例RAM角色名称集合

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the instance from which the RAM role was detached

RamRoleName.description_en: The name of the detached instance RAM role

Message.description_en: Indicates whether the instance RAM role was detached successfully. A return value of Success indicates success. Any other value indicates failure. For more information about failure causes, see error codes
Message.description_zh: 判断是否成功收回实例RAM角色。返回值为Success表示成功收回，返回其他值表示收回失败，失败原因参见错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the instance RAM role was detached successfully
Success.description_zh: 是否成功收回实例RAM角色

FailCount.description_en: The number of instances from which the RAM role failed to be detached

RamRoleName.description_en: The name of the detached instance RAM role

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances from which the RAM role was detached
